data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable prior accident year claims development of GBP 11.1m (2017 - GBP 17.3m) was experienced in 2018, spread across all lines of business, as a result of lower than expected claims development.

named_events.loss_description: 2018 losses emanating from Hurricanes Florence and Michael generated gross incurred claims of GBP 12.9m to the Syndicate and GBP 7.4m net after ceded reinsurance.
The Syndicate was also affected by the Marine Project Sassi loss that was a GBP 18.1m gross loss and GBP 1.5m net of ceded reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate carried opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 399.0m at 1 January 2018. During 2018 the Syndicate experienced a favourable prior accident year claims development of GBP 11.1m (a release), described as spread across all lines of business due to lower-than-expected claims development. In 2018 there were notable losses including Hurricanes Florence and Michael (gross GBP 12.9m, net GBP 7.4m) and the Marine Project Sassi loss (gross GBP 18.1m, net GBP 1.5m).
